# MAA DURGA PROPERTIES

MAA DURGA PROPERTIES helps people buy, sell, and rent residential, commercial, and industrial property in Haridwar.

## Website

- Properties: https://buildestate.vercel.app/properties
- Sell or rent out: https://buildestate.vercel.app/sell-property
- About: https://buildestate.vercel.app/about
- Contact: https://buildestate.vercel.app/contact
